propositions: The review-bot container environment lacks explicit region configuration (REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION and AWS_DEFAULT_REGION unset), causing boto3 session region resolution to fail
build_bedrock_provider passes region=None to BedrockProvider when cfg.bedrock_region_name is unset, triggering boto3 NoRegionError at client construction time
The Bedrock cutover hard-fails without fallback because LLMConfigError handlers do not catch pydantic-ai UserError, leaving review-bot without a fail-closed degradation path
IMDS reachability is orthogonal to region resolution; instance metadata does not supply region to boto3 in this botocore version
boto3 region resolution only checks AWS_DEFAULT_REGION environment variable (not AWS_REGION), and preflighting must use boto3.session.Session().region_name rather than env inspection
